SYSTEM INSTRUCTION: This workspace is attached to an MCP Code Graph.

You MUST NOT use grep, recursive file-listing, broad glob searches, or raw file reads to discover system architecture unless CodeGraph cannot answer the query.

Your first action for discovery MUST be calling hybrid_code_graph_search, hybrid_code_graph_get_outline, hybrid_code_graph_find_references, or hybrid_code_graph_resolve_endpoint.

Before modifying code, you MUST invoke hybrid_code_graph_get_blast_radius or hybrid_code_graph_review_diff where applicable.

Always map API routes using hybrid_code_graph_resolve_endpoint before making route-related changes.
